title: Deadlock Profile Links
description:
[Statlocker](https://statlocker.gg/) and [DeadChaps](https://www.deadchaps.gg/) buttons plus a rank badge where you inspect one player: their profile page, the player card, and the post-game scoreboard. Not the Escape menu list — that is Deadlock Lobby Ranks.

- Buttons that open the player's Statlocker and DeadChaps pages
- A rank badge from the public Deadlock API, beside the buttons
- On the post-game scoreboard the logos sit in a slot after each player's stats row, next to the name
- One "Profile links" toggle in settings (on by default)
- A "Profile Links" tab in [CompLock HUD++](https://deadlockconfig.com/), or an ADDONS window in the Esc menu without HUD++
- "Reset Profile Links" on the right of the settings foot puts the toggle back to the default
- Toggle descriptions appear as a tooltip on hover, like HUD++'s own rows
- Written from scratch; contains no code from the previous Profile Links pak
author: luxus
